scope.edition: Fantasy Flight Games original English 2008 CE01
scope.excluded: Expansions, Anniversary/later variants, flares as alien powers, summary/questions/key/readers

authority: Printed operative text, role bars and orange timing strips of each original_file image; canonical original rulebook only for meaning of use/zap and base tie rule.
global_notes: Each record is a structured paraphrase of the complete operative text, excluding fiction/history.
Player role and timing strip describe power use. Non-use text may have its own timing, as with Citadel placement and Warrior token accumulation.

A Cosmic Zap cancels one power use and bars further uses during current encounter; not all clauses on an alien sheet are uses (rulebook p12 explicitly names Warrior token accumulation and Zombie deal freeing).
Do not equate zapping with losing a power because of home-colony count.
No FAQ or summary-derived claim incorporated; followup entries are issues for parent source/FAQ reconciliation.

rules: After encounter cards are selected but before reveal, if you have at least one ship in encounter, may increase or decrease your ships there.
May remove some or all of your ships to your colonies, or add any number (even above normal maximum four) from any of your colonies.
If you win but have no ships left in the encounter, cannot receive a colony.

rules: After both main players reveal attack cards, use power to make lower total win.

rules: During each player's turn after destiny drawn, may play an attack card from hand faceup next to any planet in any system as a citadel.

Add combined value of activated citadels to defense total.
If activated and defense loses, discard citadels. If defense wins or citadels not activated, they stay.
